After reviewing the code snippet for `standardize_weights`, we can see that it checks if `y.shape[1] > 1`. If this condition is true, it attempts to retrieve the classes using `np.argmax(y, axis=1)`. However, in our case, `y` has only one column (`y.shape[1] == 1`), so `np.argmax(y, axis=1)` will raise an `IndexError: tuple index out of range`.

Therefore, the bug occurs because the function is attempting to use `np.argmax` with a single-column array, which is not supported. To fix this issue, we should modify the function to handle cases where `y.shape[1] == 1` appropriately.

Conclusion: The test `test_sample_weights()` fails due to an `IndexError` raised by `np.argmax(y, axis=1)` when called with a single-column array `y`. This error occurs because the function does not account for this edge case.
